# Security policy

Please use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/prabhuvajjiram/agis/security/advisories/new)
to report suspected vulnerabilities. If unavailable, email the maintainer at
[prabhu.vajjiram@yahoo.com](mailto:prabhu.vajjiram@yahoo.com). Do not open a public issue. Include the affected package and version, reproduction steps, impact, and any
known mitigation. Do not include customer data, credentials, npm tokens, or production records.

Only the latest published ASIG release is supported with security fixes. Acknowledgement and
remediation timing depend on severity and reproducibility.
